_comment: License policy. action: allow | allow_attribution | ask_it | unedited_only | deny | platform. Keys are normalised license ids.

public-domain.note: Public domain mark/work. Record the rights statement.

cc-by.note: Credit the author: Title, Author, Source link, License.

cc-by-sa.note: Edited versions must carry the same license. Ask IT first.

cc-by-nc.note: Fundraising/promotional use is not safely non-commercial.

cc-by-nd.note: Use only unedited: no cropping, filters or text overlays.

pexels.note: Custom platform license. Read it; limits on identifiable people and implied endorsement.

unsplash.note: Custom platform license. Read it; limits on identifiable people and implied endorsement.

pixabay.note: Custom platform license. Read it; limits on identifiable people and implied endorsement.

paid-stock.note: Keep the license receipt and note any limits on use.

own-photo.note: Need written photographer release and consent from identifiable people.
